data:
The user wants to turn Wi-Fi on. I can see the current screen is the Settings app, specifically the Internet settings page. I can see there's a Wi-Fi toggle switch that appears to be currently OFF (the toggle is on the left side and appears gray/dark).

Looking at the Wi-Fi section, I can see:
- "Wi-Fi" text with a toggle switch on the right
- The toggle switch appears to be in the OFF position (left side, gray)

I need to tap on the Wi-Fi toggle to turn it on. The toggle switch appears to be located at approximately coordinates [846, 377, 960, 422] based on the layout.

According to the instructions, I should tap the Wi-Fi toggle to turn it on. The task is to turn Wi-Fi on, and I can see it's currently off, so I need to tap the toggle to enable it.
do(action="Tap", element=[846,377])
